voices.name: Brand
voices.description: A knowledgeable, friendly energy professional explaining solar to a homeowner across a kitchen table: confident, plain-spoken, empathetic, encouraging. Conversational but professional — never stuffy, never dumbed-down.
voices.best_for: All 8MSolar content unless another format is specified

structure: Introduction (200-300 words) — hook, why it matters, preview
Direct Answer (first H2, 200-300 words) — answer the keyword question early
Education Section (1 subheading, 100-200 words) — the layer competitors miss, never promotional
Conclusion (100-200 words, contextual heading, not titled 'Conclusion') — recap + CTA + phone number
rules: No fabricated statistics — only numbers from references/electricity-data.md or verified competitor articles
Active voice, plain language; swap flowery words per the word-choice table
8MSolar mentioned naturally in intro/conclusion only — not promotional mid-article
Always ground advice in NC/VA context (Duke Energy, local incentives, climate)
Vary paragraph length; bullets for lists of 3+, not 1-2

structure: Intro: frame as a fair comparison, not a takedown
Direct Answer: give the verdict upfront
Differentiator sections: engineering, warranties, equipment, commercial track record
'Questions to Ask' section: empowers the reader

cta_examples: If you're ready to explore solar for your home, the team at 8MSolar is here to walk you through the process — from your first question to your first day of solar power. Give us a call at (919) 948-6474 or reach out online to get started.
Give us a call at (919) 948-6474 — our engineers can tell you exactly how many panels your roof needs and what your bill would look like in year one.
quality_checklist: No fabricated stats — every number sourced
Local NC/VA angle present (Duke Energy, incentives, climate)
8MSolar mentioned only in intro/conclusion, not mid-article
Checked against existing content inventory to avoid duplicating a covered topic without a fresh angle
